sn34.2:1.4: One bhikkhu is skilled in concentration but not in remaining in it.
sn34.2:1.5: One bhikkhu is skilled in remaining in concentration but is not skilled in concentration.
sn34.2:1.6: One bhikkhu is skilled neither in concentration nor in remaining in it.
sn34.2:1.7: One bhikkhu is skilled both in concentration and in remaining in it.
sn34.2:1.8: Of these, the bhikkhu skilled in concentration and in remaining in it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
sn34.2:1.9: From a cow comes milk, from milk comes curds, from curds come butter, from butter comes ghee, and from ghee comes cream of ghee. And the cream of ghee is said to be the best of these.
sn34.2:1.10: In the same way, the bhikkhu skilled in concentration and remaining in it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.”
